focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，中企需评估供应链影响
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于7月15日公布对进口自中国的纯电动汽车（BEV）反补贴调查初裁结果，拟加征17.4%至36.3%的临时关税。该措施预计于2026年11月正式实施，涉及比亚迪、上汽等主要出口车企。受影响企业应尽快启动原产地筹划、调整欧洲定价策略，并考虑在欧盟境内设立组装工厂以规避关税。
focus.title_en: EU Plans Provisional Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs, Firms Urged to Assess Supply Chain Impact
focus.summary_en: On July 15, the European Commission published its preliminary findings in the anti-subsidy investigation into battery electric vehicles (BEVs) imported from China, proposing provisional duties ranging from 17.4% to 36.3%. The measures are expected to take effect in November 2026, affecting major exporters such as BYD and SAIC. Affected companies should promptly conduct origin planning, adjust European pricing strategies, and consider establishing assembly plants within the EU to circumvent the tariffs.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁定：中国卖方因未提供合格质量证书被判违约赔偿
case.summary: 新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）近日就一起中国机械出口企业与东南亚买方之间的合同纠纷作出裁决。因中方未能按合同约定随货提供第三方质量检测证书，仲裁庭认定卖方构成根本违约，裁决中方赔偿买方约120万美元的重新采购及停工损失。此案提示出口企业：单据条款与货物质量同等重要，应严格履行合同项下所有附随义务。
case.source: 来源：SIAC 仲裁裁决（案件号不公开） · 2026年7月
case.title_en: SIAC Rules Chinese Seller Liable for Breach Due to Failure to Provide Quality Certificate
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) recently ruled in a contract dispute between a Chinese machinery exporter and a Southeast Asian buyer. Because the Chinese seller failed to deliver a third-party quality inspection certificate as contractually required, the tribunal found the seller in fundamental breach and awarded the buyer approximately USD 1.2 million in damages for replacement procurement and downtime losses. The case reminds exporters that documentary compliance is as critical as product quality; all ancillary obligations under the contract must be strictly fulfilled.
case.source_en: Source: SIAC arbitral award (case number confidential) · July 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制扩展至医疗与金融领域
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室7月14日发布通知，将大湾区个人信息跨境流动“白名单”试点范围从原有的跨境电商、供应链管理扩展至医疗健康与金融服务领域。符合条件的企业在向港澳传输必要个人信息时，可免于单独开展数据出境安全评估。企业需注意：仍需进行个人信息保护影响评估（PIA），并向网信办备案。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07.14
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow 'White List' Expanded to Healthcare and Finance
policy.summary_en: On July 14, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province announced the expansion of the 'white list' pilot for cross-border personal information flows in the Greater Bay Area from the original e-commerce and supply chain management sectors to healthcare and financial services. Eligible enterprises transferring necessary personal data to Hong Kong and Macau may be exempt from separate data export security assessments. Companies should note that a Personal Information Protection Impact Assessment (PIA) is still required and must be filed with the Cyberspace Administration.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.07.14

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体出口管制持续加码，企业应建立“合规防火墙”
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）近期更新实体清单及外国直接产品规则，将更多中国芯片设计公司列入管制。建议出海半导体企业：1）立即审查供应链中涉及美国原产技术或软件的比例；2）对最终用户和最终用途进行穿透式尽职调查；3）在海外子公司与母公司之间设置信息隔离墙，避免触发“视同出口”管制。Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. BIS has recently expanded the Entity List and tightened the Foreign Direct Product Rule, adding more Chinese chip design firms to the restrictions. I recommend that semiconductor companies going global: 1) immediately audit the proportion of U.S.-origin technology or software in their supply chains; 2) conduct look-through due diligence on end users and end uses; and 3) establish information barriers between overseas subsidiaries and the parent company to avoid triggering 'deemed export' controls.
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: U.S. Semiconductor Export Controls Tighten; Firms Should Build 'Compliance Firewalls'
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. BIS has recently expanded the Entity List and tightened the Foreign Direct Product Rule, adding more Chinese chip design firms to the restrictions. I recommend that semiconductor companies going global: 1) immediately audit the proportion of U.S.-origin technology or software in their supply chains; 2) conduct look-through due diligence on end users and end uses; and 3) establish information barriers between overseas subsidiaries and the parent company to avoid triggering 'deemed export' controls.
